content.rationale: The file's contents were fixed nowhere: pairs, count, bound, and position need shapes before any implementation can read or write them. Field-for-field mirror of the recorded marker state — markers, u, b, at — with model ints realized as op-log hex strings and the init document validating. Closed objects keep the file markers-alone; the cross-field u <= b <= length rule stays with the model invariants and the marker guards, which answer it where a reader of the file can act on it. The document carries an absolute `$id` (`urn:deccy:schema:markers`), as the node schema does, because the validator compiles a schema only under an absolute identifier (I1-schema). The schema is the one the binary carries (I1-schema-embed).
